page.layout: One column of summary lines, full width, with the running head at the top and the page number at the top left. No margin notes and no text below the list.

main_text.l: CCCXIII. Violentia in cogendis iis ad cultum Panacei Numinis adhibita.
CCCXIV. Astutia Kellionis, testificationem humanitatis suæ in levibus nonnullis captivis præstitæ, ab iisdem extorquentis.
CCCXV. Damnatio nova Pastorum, & raptatio crudelissima ad triremes.
CCCXVI. Tentationes eorundem, ut militiæ nomen dent, fortiter excussæ. Venditio eorum ad triremes, vexatio horrenda in iis, & ex iisdem Divina liberatio.

CCCXVII. Historia reliquorum Pastorum viginti, in carceribus Sarvar, Kapuvar Tergesti & Buccaris inauditis modis vexatorum quorum pars Buccari persecutioni succumbit, pars ad extremum usque eandem sustinet, & vicina jam morti liberatur.
CCCXVIII. Examen Extractus Judicialis Tyrnaviæ editi, quo author demonstrare conatur Pastores non ob religionem, sed ob rebellionem horrendam adeo tempestatem subivisse.
CCCXX. Veritas in Papatu hoc tempore erumpens, atque mox sopita iterum, circa cultum B. Virginis Mariæ.
CCCXXII. Clementi X. succedit Innocentius XI. cujus studium reformandi nonnulla, leviora licet, commendatur.
CCCXXIV. Cleri Pontificii Jesuitarum inprimis, adversus Regem Angliæ, religionem, statumque universum Angliæ terribilis conspiratio.
CCCXXV. Detecta per Titum Oatem, & suppliciis reorum magis patefacta.
CCCXXVI. Clerus in Anglia magnis ausibus excidens, ad Ecclesias Gallicanas pervertendas sese convertit.
CCCXXVII. Edicti Nannetensis, quo Ecclesiarum Gallicarum Ref. libertas nititur, historia narrata.
CCCXXVIII. Modernis persecutionibus violari illud varie ostenditur.
CCCXXIX. Nominatim in articulis concernentibus libertatem conscientiæ;

page.notes: The last two lines are on the same printed line: CCCXXIX at left, CCCXXX. Æ- set at the right. The hyphen at the end is a printed line-end hyphen. "CCCXIX.." has a double stop as printed. The line "CCCXXVIII.Modernis" has no space after the number in print, kept as a separate entry here. Some letters in the scan are faint, but the readings are clear.
